MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The Echo Show 8 feels like a useful addition to my Fire TV setup because it adds a display and video calling, giving me a reason to use it beyond watching television.",
    "The smart plug interests me because controlling a lamp would add a practical use for Alexa alongside my existing devices."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "More Fire TV sticks offer little immediate benefit because I already have a 4K stick and a Fire TV television; an HD version or themed remote cover does not meet a new need.",
    "The voice-only speakers do not solve a current problem for me, particularly if I choose the Show 8, and my TV and camera purchases do not give me a clear reason to want a tablet."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Owning Fire TV devices seems to have been taken as a reason to want many other Amazon devices, even when their functions do not interest me right now.",
    "My streaming purchases seem to have been interpreted as continuing demand for streaming sticks, even though I already have that function covered."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "What matters is whether a device adds a useful capability to what I already own, rather than repeating an existing function.",
    "My repeated camera purchases suggest that recording and monitoring matter to me alongside TV viewing; those interests are less reflected in these choices.",
    "The two smart displays are alternatives for me: I would choose the larger Show 8 this time, rather than want both."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognize my interest in connected home electronics but lean too heavily on shared branding and overlook whether each device adds something I currently need."
}
